domain: public-health infrastructure: duration-to-resolution of long-term drinking water advisories on First Nations public water systems
prediction_question: For a long-term drinking water advisory (LTDWA, in place >12 months) on a First Nations public water system in effect at month M, will the advisory be lifted within the following N months, given only advisory and system attributes knowable at M (advisory type, region, population band, corrective-measure category, months already in effect)?
prediction_time: Stateable in principle - a monthly status instant during each advisory. ISC republishes the advisory register continuously: the map page's own 'Download map data' button exports a machine-readable file with GenerateDate 2026-10-20. Not taken further: capacity and label-source availability failed first (see rejection_reason).
target_definition: Advisory lifted (lift date). The lift decision is made by a First Nations environmental public health officer after water-quality verification - a documented process, so the label semantics are sound. Measured blocker: the machine-readable export carries NO lift date. The 158 lifted-advisory records carry AdvisoryID, AdvisoryType, CategoryID, CommunityName, CommunityNum, WaterSystemName, DateSet, DateLTDWASet, DateExpected (a projected lift date), CorrectiveMeasure, LongPhase, PopulatioEstimated, RecommendedEPHO/RecommendedEPHODate/RecommendedEPHOIND, Region, coordinates - and no DateLifted. The export's own resource labels include 'AdvisoryLiftedDate' -> 'Date Advisory Lifted', so the display table intends the column, but the published data omits the value. Lift dates exist only in narrative HTML: the per-advisory tables for systems NOT financially supported by ISC (isc.gc.ca/eng/1516134315897) carry 'Date revoked (YYYY/MM/DD)', and lifts of ISC-funded advisories appear in news releases and the 'Recently lifted' list - reconstructable only by scraping prose, not from a machine-readable product.

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-22 via CKAN package_search on open.canada.ca: the ECCC CESI indicator package republishing this same LTDWA series carries license_title 'Open Government Licence - Canada'. The ISC map page carries the standard Canada.ca terms footer. licence_class A: OGL-Canada 2.0 permits commercial and non-commercial redistribution and derivatives, with attribution and no-endorsement conditions that must be carried into LICENSE.md and the card verbatim (operator caution of 2026-10-22 honoured: attribution terms recorded, not assumed away). The licence was NOT the blocker for this source.
split_strategy: Measured, and it fails. The entire event universe under the November 2015 commitment baseline is 197 advisory records: 158 lifted + 39 currently in effect (the site narrative of 2026-09-10 counts 38 active in 36 communities; the export on 2026-10-20 lists 39). DateSet years span 1995-2025, so lift events are bounded by the ~11-year program window: about 14 lift events per year, all decided by one federal program's capital-project pipeline, clustered by region (ON 110/197 events, SK 30, MB 22, BC 20, ATL 8, AB 4, QC 3) and by federal funding waves; 39 advisories are right-censored still-active. Three disjoint train/eval/holdout windows with both classes cannot be drawn from ~158 clustered positives over 11 years. Bench precedent this is measured against: npri-facility-spill-year was DROPPED on split capacity with 110-149 positives per year; this source offers ~14 per year.

measurements.probes_2026_10_22: See notes.md for exact commands. Results: map page HTTP 200, 118,470 bytes; data export HTTP 200, 2,715,200 bytes (GenerateDate 2026-10-20), read and counted locally: 755 community records, 158 lifted + 39 current advisory records = 197 events.

NO lift/end date in lifted records - the label source is absent from the machine-readable product.

rejection_reason: REJECTED on measured split capacity plus an absent label source, with the novelty question recorded as OPEN, not negative: (1) Capacity - 197 advisory events total since Nov 2015 (~14 lifts/year), clustered by region and federal funding program, 39 right-censored; three disjoint windows with both classes are impossible at this event volume (bench precedent: npri-facility-spill-year dropped at 110-149 positives/YEAR). (2) Label source - the machine-readable export carries no lift date (the one column the task needs); lift dates survive only in narrative HTML and news releases, so the label cannot be derived from a published data product. Either blocker alone closes this source. The task TYPE - duration-to-resolution of an ongoing infrastructure advisory, labels from a documented officer verification process - is genuinely unrepresented on this bench, so the door stays marked for a different publisher: a per-advisory machine-readable register with lift dates at municipal scale (e.g. a provincial or national municipal-advisory registry) could carry it.
next_action: None - dropped. Do not reopen on ISC's own products: the event universe is bounded by the program (197 advisories since 2015) and the export omits lift dates. If a per-advisory machine-readable advisory register WITH lift dates appears (provincial municipal-water channel, or ECCC's boil-water-advisory feed gaining event grain), open a new candidate for the duration-to-resolution task and cite this record for the formulation.
